messages:
Priya: Quick weekly check for NovaCart onboarding 90m spike in errors overnight. Sharing numbers and top failing URIs.
Jamal: paste stats pls
Priya: 01:00-07:00 UTC:
- total error rate: 5.2% (baseline 0.6%)
- 5xx: 3.6% (502/503)
- gateway timeouts: 1.1%
- rate-limits (429): 0.5%
Priya: Top endpoints by error volume:
1) POST /v1/generate (42%)
2) POST /v1/streaming/chat (15%)
3) POST /v1/embeddings (12%)
4) POST /v1/batch/score (9%)
5) GET /v1/model/health (6%)
Priya: Example logs:
[2026-03-22T01:42:13Z] id=nx01 route=/v1/generate status=502 backend=runtime-io msg="upstream EOF"
[2026-03-22T01:42:18Z] id=nx02 route=/v1/generate latency=5.6s gateway_timeout=true
[2026-03-22T01:43:05Z] id=nx10 route=/v1/embeddings status=429 key_qps=72
Elsa: Any recent prod pushes? @infra-bot
infra-bot: deploy-bot: prod rollout r-2026-03-22-0030 completed at 2026-03-22T00:30:12Z (runtime-v2.4, batching-svc-v2.0).
Jamal: rollout aligns. Initial hypothesis: runtime-v2.4 kernel issue causing EPIPE on heavy batches + client workload burst (seq len +50%).
Tomas: NovaCart is in ramp; high risk for renewal if demo flows fail. Priya: suggest we send an interim message to their CSM.
Priya: Proposed quick mitigations:
- route NovaCart POST /v1/generate to runtime-v2.3 canary (start 5%)
- bump batching timeout 36->6s for high-latency routes
- apply temporary per-key throttle (50 qps) for keys with sustained bursts
Elsa: will apply 5% canary now and enable verbose runtime traces for 45m.
Jamal: I'll provision extra runtime-v2.3 nodes and check kernel OOM/EPIPE counts.
Priya: Action items: Jamal (remediate hosts), Elsa (logs+canary), Priya (CSM note), Tomas (renewal ops standby). Update in 30m with verification metrics.
infra-bot: alert-summary: 82% of 502s from two us-east hosts (i-0b1c2d3e, i-0b1c2d3f).
